description: Synteny-anchored test: is a Vam10p-like antisense ORF present in the VPS5 gene across 18 Saccharomycetaceae species?
code:
import requests, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
EU="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
def jget(u,p,tries=4):
    for k in range(tries):
        try:
            d=S.get(u,params=p,timeout=60).json()
            if "esearchresult" in d or "result" in d: return d
        except Exception: pass
        time.sleep(1.5)
    return {}
def ef(acc,s,e,st):
    for k in range(3):
        try:
            t=S.get(EU+"efetch.fcgi",params=dict(db="nuccore",id=acc,rettype="fasta",retmode="text",
                    seq_start=s,seq_stop=e,strand=st),timeout=120).text
            q="".join(t.split("\n")[1:]).upper()
            if q: return q
        except Exception: pass
        time.sleep(1.5)
    return ""

GENES = {  # species -> (NCBI GeneID for VPS5, clade)
 "S. cerevisiae":("854235","Saccharomyces"), "S. paradoxus":("54633636","Saccharomyces"),
 "S. mikatae":("80921287","Saccharomyces"), "S. kudriavzevii":("80927111","Saccharomyces"),
 "S. eubayanus":("28934048","Saccharomyces"),
 "N. glabratus":("2891033","post-WGD non-Saccharomyces"), "K. africana":("13885848","post-WGD non-Saccharomyces"),
 "K. naganishii":("34528585","post-WGD non-Saccharomyces"), "N. dairenensis":("11497156","post-WGD non-Saccharomyces"),
 "T. phaffii":("11533094","post-WGD non-Saccharomyces"), "H. blattae":("14492685","post-WGD non-Saccharomyces"),
 "T. delbrueckii":("11504303","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae"), "Z. rouxii":("8201976","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae"),
 "L. thermotolerans":("8293188","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae"), "K. lactis":("2895646","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae"),
 "K. marxianus":("34715552","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae"), "E. gossypii":("4620469","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae"),
 "E. cymbalariae":("11472381","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae"),
}
sm=jget(EU+"esummary.fcgi",dict(db="gene",id=",".join(g for g,_ in GENES.values()),retmode="json")).get("result",{})
SEQS={}
for nm,(gid,clade) in GENES.items():
    gi=sm.get(gid,{}).get("genomicinfo")
    if not gi: continue
    L=gi[0];a,b=int(L["chrstart"]),int(L["chrstop"])
    s,e,st=(a+1,b+1,1) if a<=b else (b+1,a+1,2)
    q=ef(L["chraccver"],s,e,st)
    if q: SEQS[nm]=q
    time.sleep(0.35)
print("VPS5 genes retrieved:", len(SEQS), "of", len(GENES))

bases="TCAG";aas="FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
CODON={};i=0
for b1 in bases:
    for b2 in bases:
        for b3 in bases:
            CODON[b1+b2+b3]=aas[i];i+=1
tr=lambda s:"".join(CODON.get(s[k:k+3],"X") for k in range(0,len(s)-2,3))
COMP=str.maketrans("ACGTN","TGCAN"); rc=lambda s:s.translate(COMP)[::-1]
VAM10="MLFEVFGEVLASYIVSSKTKGELAFPVNNAPPDSLVAINCVVLFLRSAIGSCSGAKELIRSSALELSCSSSCGLPATDKPGSFHSGALSKSILSANEAVVSKSSLSFLSSFVDI"
qa=np.frombuffer(VAM10.encode(),dtype="S1"); L=len(VAM10)
def best_ident(p):
    t=np.frombuffer(p.encode(),dtype="S1")
    if len(t)<L: return -1.0,-1
    best=-1.0;bi=-1
    for s in range(len(t)-L+1):
        v=float((qa==t[s:s+L]).sum())/L
        if v>best: best,bi=v,s
    return best,bi

rows=[]
for nm,g in SEQS.items():
    r=rc(g); bb=-1.0; bf=(None,None); bseq=""
    for f in range(3):
        p=tr(r[f:]); v,pos=best_ident(p)
        if v>bb: bb,bf,bseq=v,(f,pos),p[pos:pos+L]
    rows.append(dict(species=nm, clade=GENES[nm][1], vps5_aa=len(tr(g).rstrip("*")),
                     id_pct=round(100*bb,1), frame=bf[0], offset=bf[1], stops=bseq.count("*")))

# Null: 300 shuffled Vam10p queries vs every species' antisense frames
rng=np.random.default_rng(1); null=[]
allframes=[tr(rc(g)[f:]) for g in SEQS.values() for f in range(3)]
arrs=[np.frombuffer(p.encode(),dtype="S1") for p in allframes]
for _ in range(300):
    sh=np.frombuffer("".join(rng.permutation(list(VAM10))).encode(),dtype="S1")
    b=0.0
    for t in arrs:
        for s in range(0,len(t)-L+1,3):
            v=float((sh==t[s:s+L]).sum())/L
            if v>b: b=v
    null.append(100*b)
null=np.array(null); n95=np.percentile(null,95)

df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
order=["S. cerevisiae","S. paradoxus","S. mikatae","S. kudriavzevii","S. eubayanus",
       "N. glabratus","K. africana","K. naganishii","N. dairenensis","T. phaffii","H. blattae",
       "T. delbrueckii","Z. rouxii","L. thermotolerans","K. lactis","K. marxianus","E. gossypii","E. cymbalariae"]
df["o"]=df.species.map({s:i for i,s in enumerate(order)}); df=df.sort_values("o")
print(df[["species","clade","vps5_aa","id_pct","frame","offset","stops"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nShuffled-query null over all antisense frames: mean %.1f%%, 95th pct %.1f%%, max %.1f%% (n=300)"%(null.mean(),n95,null.max()))

cmap={"Saccharomyces":"#c2410c","post-WGD non-Saccharomyces":"#0369a1","pre-WGD Saccharomycetaceae":"#4d7c0f"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,7))
y=np.arange(len(df))[::-1]
ax.barh(y, df.id_pct, color=[cmap[c] for c in df.clade])
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(df.species)
ax.axvspan(0,n95,color="grey",alpha=0.15)
ax.axvline(n95,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax.text(n95+1,len(df)-1.5,"95th pct of shuffled-query null (%.1f%%)"%n95,fontsize=9)
for yy,(idp,st) in zip(y, zip(df.id_pct,df.stops)):
    ax.text(idp+1, yy, f"{idp:.0f}%  ({st} stop{'s' if st!=1 else ''})", va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,112); ax.set_xlabel("Best ungapped identity to Vam10p across the 3 antisense frames of the VPS5 gene (%)")
ax.set_title("VAM10 is detectable only inside Saccharomyces sensu stricto,\nat the same antisense position within the deeply conserved VPS5 gene")
h=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=v) for v in cmap.values()]
ax.legend(h, cmap.keys(), loc="lower right", fontsize=9, frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
